title: NSE Forecasting — Naive / LightGBM / Chronos Zero-Shot Walk-Forward Benchmark

modules.dataset: NSE OHLCV ETL via yfinance (with synthetic GBM fallback). 40 technical indicators: lag (5), rolling mean/std/min/max (4), daily/log returns, EMA, RSI. ADF stationarity check (returns = stationary, prices = non-stationary). Walk-forward split generator with strict temporal integrity (train precedes test, no row overlap).
modules.model: Four forecasters via one API (fit/predict): Naive persistence, LightGBM (3 quantile regressors for p10/p50/p90 intervals), Amazon Chronos (T5 zero-shot via HuggingFace), and a lightweight 2-layer transformer fallback for offline environments. Walk-forward evaluation with MAE/RMSE/MAPE/Directional Accuracy/Pinball/Coverage metrics.
modules.tests: 18 tests: synthetic OHLCV schema, lag features backward (no lookahead leakage — verified per-row), rolling windows right-aligned, target_next_close forward shift, ADF on constant/random walk/returns, walk-forward train-precedes-test + no overlap + window sizes, MAE/RMSE/MAPE/DirAcc/Pinball math (hand-verified), naive/LightGBM/walk-forward sanity, CLI smoke.

entry_point: python train.py [--symbol ^NSEI] [--use-yfinance] [--models naive lightgbm transformer_fallback] --metrics-json metrics.json
